link_source_system.description: The system whose shared alias key joins the pair (observed value `D365_BUSINESS_CENTRAL`).

object_entity_id.description: The linked object's canonical spine entity id (observed: an opportunity).

object_entity_type.description: The linked object's spine entity type (observed: `opportunity`).

object_external_id.description: The source system's natural key the two entities share — the join key the link is derived on.

outcome.description: The linked object's outcome at materialisation time (`won`/`lost`/`open`).

relation.description: The link direction/type, as declared by the org's `EntityLinkSpec.relation` (observed value `originated_from_opportunity`).

subject_entity_id.description: The subject entity the fact is anchored to (observed: a `project`).

summary.description: The composed human-readable sentence about the link.

value.description: The linked opportunity's estimated value (BC `Estimated_Value_LCY`, AUD by default).
